description: MCP template/assembly tools: document_editor_insert_token (TokenRun at a plain-text offset incl. computed expressions, optional key validation against IDocumentTokenValueProvider), document_editor_wrap_conditional (IF/ELSEIF/ELSE content-control chains via DocumentAssemblyMetadata + branch/expression updates), document_editor_insert_repeating_section (row template bound to a collection token), document_template_describe (tokens, conditional chains, repeating sections overview) and document_assemble_render (template + tokenValues → PNG/PDF via TempoDocumentService with IF/ELSE evaluation, repeat expansion and computed expressions). Authoring compiles into convergence-tested insertBlock/updateBlock/deleteBlock operations.
